items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Catman, a saxophone player when you was there was it? I can't remember. No. I don't think it was when you came there that Smitty the piano player, Joe Snider and myself was playing at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah I used to come there.

Well at that time that I'm speaking about was before that time because this particular job there was Joe Snider's job where we, the other band had broke up, Joe Snider, later years got that job up there and Catman, a saxophone player when you was there was it? I can't remember. No. I don't think it was when you came there that Smitty the piano player, Joe Snider and myself was playing at that time.
I think it was just three pieces.
